text: A dark theme, Night Jade: the ink landscape at night, a dark jade board with gold lines, and the same cinnabar and ink pieces. Choose light, dark or follow the system under More > Appearance; switching keeps your game and review.
新增深色主题「墨玉夜山」：水墨山水染成夜色，深青玉棋盘配金色棋线，棋子依旧朱砂红、墨色。在「更多」→「界面主题」里可选浅色、深色或跟随系统，默认跟随系统；切换时棋局和复盘都不会中断。
